summary: QuickLogic filed an 8-K on April 29, 2026, reporting entry into a $10.0 million secured revolving credit facility with Sunflower Bank, N.A., maturing April 24, 2029. Interest is the greater of 5.50% or Prime plus 0.50%, secured by substantially all assets, with a $30,000 annual fee. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. Covenants include a 7-month liquidity requirement and limitations on debt, liens, investments, and acquisitions. This is a routine credit facility, not a special situation.
